bloodlines.name: Morbus
bloodlines.summary: Mekhet who carry and spread disease, often passing themselves off as ordinary Shadows.

bane.name: The Unclean Curse
bane.summary: Healthy mortal blood can't sustain them; they must feed on the diseased, though Kindred blood still nourishes. They also keep the Mekhet bane.

disciplines.name: Cachexy
disciplines.summary: Sense, spread and worsen the diseases the vampire has carried.

powers.name: Diagnose
powers.summary: Sense who nearby carries a disease, including hidden infections.

powers.name: Contaminate

cost.note: Spilled on the object or area

powers.summary: Taint an object or small area so that anyone touching it risks infection.

powers.name: Inflame
powers.summary: Make a mortal's illness flare up, penalising their rolls for a few turns.

powers.name: Plague-Bearer
powers.summary: Spread a chosen disease to people around the vampire, turn after turn.

powers.name: Accelerate Disease
powers.summary: Drive a victim's disease to deal lethal damage within minutes; not on Kindred.

covenants.name: Gallows Post
covenants.summary: Messengers, guides and highwaymen who keep Kindred society connected by carrying word and travellers along the dangerous roads and seas between cities. Its members may take Carthian Law Merits, using their Gallows Post Status.

covenants.name: Al-Hamasoun
covenants.summary: Muslim Kindred mystics who take Iblis, who refused to bow to Adam, as their model, and make it their duty to tempt mortals away from God. Frequent rivals of the Lancea et Sanctum.
